caption: The drawing shows a single large stoneware jug, depicted in an upright position. The jug has a cylindrical body that gradually narrows into a short, broad neck with a rounded lip and a looped handle connecting the neck to the shoulder. The surface of the jug is primarily a tan or beige color, with darker and lighter areas suggesting texture and shading. On the front of the jug, there is a blue decorative design featuring stylized leaves and swirls, as well as a blue painted text reading “W. T. MOOR, AKRON, SUMMIT CO. OH.” The jug occupies the center of a plain, light background, without any additional objects or scenery.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
